Answer: Dunno, you should ask your doctor, I don’t think he has any scientific evidence to back up his claim, he just seems to want to reassure you all. As for the underlying why, your son would need a work-up what was wrong with him. Most people would start having a standard urological evaluation to exclude the rare physical issues, after that seeing a psychologist to look into the underlying issue.

Question: What are the side effects of PID treatment?
Answer: To start with, don’t use abbreviations when asking a question, since many disciplines (of medicine even) use the same acronyms for different conditions. Pelvic infectious disease? The treatment does not cause any issues, but the infection in females can lead to blocked Fallopian tubes, thus infertility.

Question: When I open my mouth wide, it made a pop sound. Ever since I did an ear irrigation, this started to happen. What do I do, and what is this?
